# Lava fall over the rim: a 0.2 m thick sheet hugging the cliff, running 6 m down into the void and
# slanting 0.5 m out, and salmon globs falling along it in a seamless loop: 10 identical 0.6 m fields
# stacked along the stream, copy c set 0.03 m * c further out than the sheet (the top copies are hidden
# inside it, so globs emerge from the lava and peel away as they fall); the stream moves one copy per
# 1 s. Local frame: the cliff face is x = 0, island inside at x < 0. Generated by make_env.py.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 12
material new Fall --base-color 0.773 0.227 0.616 --emission 0.773 0.227 0.616 --no-slot
material new Glob --base-color 1.000 0.557 0.502 --emission 1.000 0.557 0.502 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Lip --size 1 --location -0.15 0 -0.04
scale 0.5 0.7 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Fall
add mesh cube --name Sheet --size 1 --location 0.06 0 -3.0
scale 0.2 0.62 6.0
apply --scale
material assign Fall
active Sheet
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -1"
translate 0.5 0 0
mode object
add mesh cube --name G0_0 --size 0.14 --location 0.074 0.024 -0.171
add mesh cube --name G0_1 --size 0.14 --location 0.098 -0.014 -0.455

select G0_0 G0_1 G0_2 G0_3 G1_0 G1_1 G1_2 G1_3 G2_0 G2_1 G2_2 G2_3 G3_0 G3_1 G3_2 G3_3 G4_0 G4_1 G4_2 G4_3 G5_0 G5_1 G5_2 G5_3 G6_0 G6_1 G6_2 G6_3 G7_0 G7_1 G7_2 G7_3 G8_0 G8_1 G8_2 G8_3 G9_0 G9_1 G9_2 G9_3

rename G0_0 Globs
material assign Glob
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor

set location 0.0800 0 -0.6

frame set 0

export lavafall.glb --bake-animations
